quest.title: Kanra's Thoughts
quest.description: Narukami Island's Kanra would like to have 5 Sakura Blooms.

talks.objective: Give five Sakura Blooms to Kanra

dialogues.speaker: Kanra
dialogues.text: You saw my commission? Have you managed to get 5 Sakura Blooms?

response.speaker: Kanra
response.text: Okay. Well, you know where to find me when you've got them.

dialogues.speaker: Kanra
dialogues.text: Thank you. You know, since the man I love left to join the war, I've not heard one shred of news...

dialogues.speaker: Kanra
dialogues.text: These days, I worry about him at every waking moment. Only the sight of the Sacred Sakura's blossoms can soothe my mind a little.

dialogues.speaker: Kanra
dialogues.text: The reason is that before he left, he swore on the Sacred Sakura that he would return safely to me.
